title: Surreal Dreamscape Portal
description: A surreal painting of a pale, bald figure with wide eyes emerging from a torn spiral notebook page. The figure's body transforms into a vibrant blue cosmic wave containing knights on horseback carrying flags, floating books, and flowers, while bright yellow rays emanate from their head against a background of blooming flowers, a red sun, and a mosaic library tree.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork of a pale bald androgynous figure with wide eyes breaking through a torn spiral notebook page. Their torso dissolves into a flowing blue cosmic river filled with knights on horseback carrying flags, floating books, and blue flowers. Bright yellow energy rays burst from the figure's head. Background features a giant white lily, red poppies, orange marigolds, a glowing red sun, and a tree made of mosaic bookshelves with visible roots.
